disputes.a: PowerPyx: the balcony meditation adds +1 to the Progress Menu counter but is NOT marked as a Meditation Spot like the rest.
disputes.b: KeenGamer: treat it as the only potentially missable interaction; do it in Chapter 1.
disputes.call: DO IT in Chapter 1. PowerPyx's author did it and then earned the trophy. Unconfirmed whether it is required, so we show both versions.
disputes.topic: Meditation #1 — does the Chapter 1 balcony meditation count?

disputes.a: PowerPyx lists 'In The Beginning…', 'Capital Offense', 'Bad Luck, I Guess', 'The Truth Is Out There' and 'Ten Pin' as unconfirmed.
disputes.b: KeenGamer gives partial descriptions for 'In The Beginning…' (cocktail, Ocean Beach) and 'Capital Offense' (vehicle showroom escape) but marks the exact triggers unconfirmed.
disputes.call: We list the partial descriptions as leads only and flag all five UNCONFIRMED. No guess is presented as a working method.
disputes.topic: Five trophies with no confirmed method

disputes.a: PowerPyx + GTABase report a trophy called 'Irredeemable' as permanent (check the Criminal Progression).
disputes.b: The 55-name list agreed by Exophase, PSNProfiles, KeenGamer and EGamers contains no trophy called 'Irredeemable'.
disputes.call: We do NOT list 'Irredeemable' as one of the 55. It may be a renamed/early name or a different list; we flag it here instead of silently dropping it.
disputes.topic: 'Irredeemable' — a trophy name that does not appear in the 55

disputes.a: PowerPyx: all trophy-related quest givers return in free-roam, so nothing is missable.
disputes.b: Some lists note only certain strands qualify (e.g. Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete count; Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy do not).
disputes.call: Do the 8 qualifying strands in free-roam after the story; the exact qualifying set is still being confirmed by the guides.
disputes.topic: Stranger strands — which ones count for Strangers & Freaks?

disputes.a: Optional missions can disappear (black icons, pink letters), some fences become permanently unavailable, a few magazines sit in story buildings that close.
disputes.b: PowerPyx: none of it blocks any trophy or 100%.
disputes.call: Do not restart a save over these. Only Positive Mental Attitude has a missable risk.
disputes.topic: Missable content that does NOT affect trophies

framework.cheats: Cheats disable trophies and saving (GTABase, TechWiser)
framework.completionChecklist: Viewable only after the story; progress made during the story counts
framework.missable: Positive Mental Attitude is the only possibly missable trophy (PowerPyx, GTABase, KeenGamer)
framework.missionReplay: No mission replay, no mission gold medals

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.req: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. ONLY possibly missable trophy: after the mission 'Down to Earth', talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and choose 'Accept'. It adds +1 to the Progress Menu counter but is NOT marked as a Meditation Spot — it is unconfirmed whether it is required. PowerPyx's author did it and then earned the trophy, so the safe call is: DO IT in Chapter 1.
